notes.title: Steam Leaderboard Added! Unity Version Updated!

Steam Leaderboard Added! Unity Version Updated!
I've added a leaderboard to show the top 10 highscores!
I've also updated the game to unity 2019. This means you will have to change resolution settings on the main menu. I'm still working on adding the graphics settings to the main menu so for now it should just run on default medium settings.
